lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple columns of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a semi-regular grid; spot diameter and inter-spot distance decrease moving anteriorly toward the pectoral fin base.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centroids of the larger circular blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes across the posterior-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a luminance gradient transitioning from highlights on the dorsal edge to subtle shadowing on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The visible pectoral fin exhibits a high-density distribution of small-diameter high-luminance spots, distinct from the larger grid-like patterning on the primary trunk.
